## Task 2

```{r}
count_above <- function(x,numbers) { # You are creating a unique function.
  count <- 0
  
  for (i in 1:length(x)) { # you are telling R what boundary you want to set, in this case, length.
    if (x>number) { # You are telling R the range of lengths you want to include
      count <- count + 1 #
    }
  }
  return(count) # You are telling R to return your data from the function.
}
```
